title: Python: pickle.load() with untrusted source
detail: Deserialization of untrusted pickle data → RCE. From BugHunter hunt-deserialization: pickle.loads() without allow_pickle guard. Use json or safe serialization.
fix: Replace with json.loads() for data. If pickle is required, only unpickle data from trusted sources with cryptographic signatures.

title: Python: yaml.load() unsafe deserialization
detail: yaml.load() without SafeLoader → arbitrary code execution. From BugHunter hunt-deserialization. Use yaml.safe_load() or yaml.load(data, Loader=yaml.SafeLoader).
fix: Replace with yaml.safe_load(data) or yaml.load(data, Loader=yaml.SafeLoader).

title: Python: subprocess with user-controlled input
detail: String concatenation in subprocess command → command injection. From BugHunter hunt-rce. Use argument list: subprocess.run(['cmd', arg], shell=False).
fix: Use subprocess.run(['cmd', arg1, arg2], shell=False) or shlex.quote() for shell strings.

title: Python: SSRF via requests without URL validation
detail: User-controlled URL in HTTP request → SSRF. From BugHunter hunt-ssrf. Validate URL against allowlist before requesting.
fix: Validate URL against allowlist. Block internal IPs (127.0.0.0/8, 10.0.0.0/8, 169.254.0.0/16, etc.). Use urllib.parse for validation.

title: Python: SSTI via render_template_string with user input
detail: User input passed to Jinja2 render_template_string → server-side template injection. From BugHunter hunt-ssti. Never pass user input to template rendering.
fix: Use render_template() with separate template files. Never pass user input to render_template_string(). Sanitize with Jinja2 sandbox.

title: Python: XML parsing without defusedxml
detail: XML parsing without defusedxml → XXE/Billion Laughs attack. From BugHunter hunt-xxe. Use defusedxml or disable external entities.
fix: Use defusedxml.ElementTree.parse() instead of xml.etree.ElementTree.parse(). Or set parser with resolve_entities=False.

title: Python: os.path.join for file access without validation
detail: Path traversal risk: os.path.join with user input → LFI. From BugHunter hunt-lfi. Validate and sanitize paths against base directory.
fix: Use pathlib.Path resolution: Path(base).resolve() / user_path.lstrip('/'). Validate resolved path is within base directory.

title: Python: NoSQL injection via dict parameters in MongoDB
detail: MongoDB query with $ operators from user input → NoSQL injection. From BugHunter hunt-nosqli. Sanitize or use mongo-sanitize.
fix: Import mongo_sanitize and sanitize user input: sanitize(user_dict). Or validate no $ operators in keys.

title: Python: LDAP injection via string formatting
detail: LDAP query with user input via format/f-string → LDAP injection. From BugHunter hunt-ldap. Escape special chars: * ( ) \ NUL.
fix: Use ldap3.utils.conv.escape_filter_chars() to sanitize user input before LDAP queries.

title: Python: File upload without content-type validation
detail: File upload without MIME-type validation → malicious file upload. From BugHunter hunt-file-upload. Validate content-type and extension against allowlist.
fix: Validate MIME type: import magic; mime = magic.from_buffer(file.read(2048), mime=True). Check extension against allowlist. Save outside webroot.

title: Python: eval/exec with user input
detail: eval/exec with potentially user-controlled input → RCE. From BugHunter hunt-rce. Never eval() user input. Use ast.literal_eval() for safe evaluation.
fix: Use ast.literal_eval() for Python literals only. For dynamic execution, use restricted Python sandbox or subprocess with limited permissions.

title: Python: CORS misconfiguration — allow all origins
detail: CORS: Access-Control-Allow-Origin: * — from BugHunter hunt-cors. Allows any origin to access resources. Restrict to specific origins.
fix: Set specific origin: Access-Control-Allow-Origin: https://example.com. Never use * with credentials.
